definitions.explanation: The art or craft of carving objects from wood, or an object made through this process.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{木彫|きぼ}りの{熊|くま}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: My grandfather made a wooden carved bear.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}では{木彫|きぼ}りの{民芸品|みんげいひん}が{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Hokkaido is famous for its wood-carved folk crafts.

examples.japanese: {木彫|きぼ}りを{趣味|しゅみ}にしている。
examples.english: I do wood carving as a hobby.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{木彫|きぼ}り is a traditional craft in Japan. {北海道|ほっかいどう} is particularly famous for Ainu-style wood carvings, especially {木彫|きぼ}りの{熊|くま} (carved wooden bears).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{木彫|きぼ}りの{像|ぞう} (wood-carved statue)
・{木彫|きぼ}りの{熊|くま} (carved wooden bear)
・{木彫|きぼ}り{細工|ざいく} (wood carving work)
・{木彫|きぼ}り{師|し} (wood carver)

RELATED TERMS:
・{彫刻|ちょうこく} (sculpture)
・{竹細工|たけざいく} (bamboo craft)
